ja: ラドマス: これはこれは。

key: This is quite a mess, isn't it?
en: This is quite a mess, isn't it?
ja: ずいぶんな有様じゃないか。

key: That lad dropped me off here and went to search for the way forward, and here we are.
en: That lad dropped me off here and went to search for the way forward, and here we are.
ja: あの若造が私をここに置いて、先に進む道を探しに行ってしまってね、それでこうなったわけだ。

key: I feel that I can safely assume you've had some experience with these contraptions by now, and I believe I've a solid enough understanding of it.
en: I feel that I can safely assume you've had some experience with these contraptions by now, and I believe I've a solid enough understanding of it.
ja: 君はもうこの手の仕掛けに慣れているだろうし、私もこれについてはしっかり理解できたと思う。

key: Shall we get right to it?
en: Shall we get right to it?

key: But I will say... looking at this data...
en: But I will say... looking at this data...
ja: だが言わせてもらうと…このデータを見る限り…

key: Whoever designed this surely had either a veritable sadistic streak, or a very good sense of humor.
en: Whoever designed this surely had either a veritable sadistic streak, or a very good sense of humor.
ja: これを設計した者は、真性のサディストか、よほどのユーモアの持ち主に違いない。

key: I suspect we shall never find out which.
en: I suspect we shall never find out which.
ja: どちらなのかは、永遠にわからないだろうな。

key: RADOMUS: What will your move be?
en: RADOMUS: What will your move be?
ja: ラドマス: どう動く?

key: RADOMUS: Very well. This will be a mite complicated...
en: RADOMUS: Very well. This will be a mite complicated...
ja: ラドマス: よろしい。これは少々複雑になりそうだ…

key: RADOMUS: If there were an award for the most inefficient data system in all of history, they surely would have won it.
en: RADOMUS: If there were an award for the most inefficient data system in all of history, they surely would have won it.
ja: ラドマス: 史上最も非効率的なデータシステムに賞があるとすれば、間違いなくこれが受賞していただろう。

key: RADOMUS: Shall we try? Very well.
en: RADOMUS: Shall we try? Very well.
ja: ラドマス: 試してみようか。よろしい。

key: I will fetch Hardy from wherever he's gotten to exploring, and we'll go on ahead.
en: I will fetch Hardy from wherever he's gotten to exploring, and we'll go on ahead.
ja: ハーディがどこを探検しているにせよ、連れ戻して先に進むとしよう。

key: RADOMUS: It would seem that wasn't quite it.
en: RADOMUS: It would seem that wasn't quite it.
ja: ラドマス: どうやら、それは違ったようだな。

key: Permit me just a moment to try something on my end...
en: Permit me just a moment to try something on my end...
ja: こちらで少し試してみるので、しばし待ってくれ…

key: There is no use in holding ourselves against systems this arbitrary.
en: There is no use in holding ourselves against systems this arbitrary.
ja: これほど恣意的なシステムに対して、自分を責めても仕方がない。

key: Ah, but I believe I'm putting the pieces together myself.
en: Ah, but I believe I'm putting the pieces together myself.
ja: ああ、だが自分でも少しずつわかってきた気がする。

key: Take another try, and give me just another moment more to perfect an approach.
en: Take another try, and give me just another moment more to perfect an approach.
ja: もう一度試してくれ。私もやり方を完成させるのにもう少し時間をくれ。

key: This will continue to be rather challenging until you can properly draw the necessary inferences.
en: This will continue to be rather challenging until you can properly draw the necessary inferences.
ja: 必要な推論をきちんと導き出せるようになるまで、これはずっと難しいままだろう。

key: Let's take this clue as an example:
en: Let's take this clue as an example:
ja: この手がかりを例に取ろう:

key: 5. The Hardness of the "Small" gem is less than the Hardness of the Amethyst, which is less than the Hardness of the "Pure" Gem.
en: 5. The Hardness of the "Small" gem is less than the Hardness of the Amethyst, which is less than the Hardness of the "Pure" Gem.
ja: 5. 「小」の宝石の硬度はアメジストの硬度より低く、アメジストの硬度は「純粋」な宝石の硬度より低い。

key: It may not appear to give us any concrete information at first, but that's far from the case.
en: It may not appear to give us any concrete information at first, but that's far from the case.
ja: 一見具体的な情報を与えてくれないように見えるかもしれないが、実際はそうではない。

key: If the "Small" gem is softer than Amethyst, then we know that Amethyst is not "Small".
en: If the "Small" gem is softer than Amethyst, then we know that Amethyst is not "Small".
ja: 「小」の宝石がアメジストより柔らかいなら、アメジストは「小」ではないとわかる。

key: Conversely, we also hereby know that Amethyst is not "Pure", and further that the "Small" gem is not "Pure".
en: Conversely, we also hereby know that Amethyst is not "Pure", and further that the "Small" gem is not "Pure".
ja: 逆に、アメジストは「純粋」ではなく、さらに「小」の宝石も「純粋」ではないともわかる。

key: This allows us to rule out several possibilities-- and of course, it is only one clue.
en: This allows us to rule out several possibilities-- and of course, it is only one clue.
ja: これでいくつかの可能性を除外できる――もちろん、これは手がかりの一つに過ぎないが。

key: With eight such similar ones, I have faith that inferring these eliminated possibilities will reveal only one possible outcome.
en: With eight such similar ones, I have faith that inferring these eliminated possibilities will reveal only one possible outcome.
ja: 似たようなものが八つあれば、除外された可能性を推論していくことで、答えは一つに絞られると信じている。

key: But that may be difficult to imagine without marking it down visually somehow.
en: But that may be difficult to imagine without marking it down visually somehow.
ja: だが、何らかの形で目に見えるように書き記さなければ、想像するのは難しいだろう。

key: Surely you have not come this far without being able to do so?
en: Surely you have not come this far without being able to do so?
ja: まさか、それができずにここまで来たわけではあるまい?

key: This system is rather unfortunate, isn't it?
en: This system is rather unfortunate, isn't it?
ja: このシステムはなかなか不運なものだな。

key: It's nearly a miracle that the constructor of this convoluted contraption considered to create such things.
en: It's nearly a miracle that the constructor of this convoluted contraption considered to create such things.
ja: この入り組んだ仕掛けを作った者が、こんなものまで用意していたとは、ほとんど奇跡だな。

key: Simply read the available dataset as if they were 'clues' to a puzzle.
en: Simply read the available dataset as if they were 'clues' to a puzzle.
ja: 利用可能なデータセットを、パズルの「手がかり」だと思って読めばいい。

key: Using your powers of logic, deduction, and perhaps drawing a lot of boxes on paper, figure out all the qualities each of four crystals has.
en: Using your powers of logic, deduction, and perhaps drawing a lot of boxes on paper, figure out all the qualities each of four crystals has.
ja: 論理と推理の力を使い、おそらく紙に大量の枠を描きながら、4つの結晶それぞれが持つすべての性質を突き止めるのだ。

key: We then input those qualities as data back into the system by moving the colored blocks to our right in line with the screens displaying those qualities.
en: We then input those qualities as data back into the system by moving the colored blocks to our right in line with the screens displaying those qualities.
ja: その性質がわかったら、右手にある色付きブロックを、その性質を表示する画面に合わせて動かし、データとしてシステムに入力する。

key: For example, a Ruby with a "Coxcomb" Habit requires the red block to be moved in front of the screen that reads "Coxcomb".
en: For example, a Ruby with a "Coxcomb" Habit requires the red block to be moved in front of the screen that reads "Coxcomb".
ja: たとえば、晶癖が「鶏冠状」のルビーなら、赤いブロックを「鶏冠状」と書かれた画面の前に動かす必要がある。

key: It is tedious and nonsensical, but then, aren't all things?
en: It is tedious and nonsensical, but then, aren't all things?
ja: 退屈で無意味な作業だが、まあ、この世のすべてがそうではないか?

key: Pick your head up and hold it high!
en: Pick your head up and hold it high!

key: When everything seems lost and you're at the end of the road, I want you to remind yourself, to never give up, and never stop fighting.
en: When everything seems lost and you're at the end of the road, I want you to remind yourself, to never give up, and never stop fighting.
ja: すべてを失ったように思えて、行き止まりに立たされた時、絶対に諦めるな、戦い続けろと、自分に言い聞かせてほしい。

key: Skip Victory Road Gem Logic on this file?
en: Skip Victory Road Gem Logic on this file?
ja: このファイルでチャンピオンロードの宝石ロジックをスキップする?

key: Victory Road Gem Logic completion has been detected from a different save file.
en: Victory Road Gem Logic completion has been detected from a different save file.
ja: 別のセーブファイルでチャンピオンロードの宝石ロジックのクリアが確認された。
